name: Kellogg’s Millet Muesli
ingredients_raw: MULTIGRAIN MIX (77%){CORN GRITS & CORN MEAL (24%), WHEAT & WHEAT FLOUR (ATTA) (20%), RICE & RICE FLOUR (14%), RAGI MILLET FLOUR (12%), ROLLED BARLEY (6%)), SUGAR, DRY FRUITS & SEEDS (7%) (RAISINS (5%) [BLACK RAISINS (2.5%), BLACK CURRANTS (2.5%)], PUMPKIN SEEDS (2%)), CEREAL EXTRACT, OLIGOFRUCTOSE, WHEAT BRAN, IODIZED SALT, COCOA SOLIDS, VITAMINS, FLAVOURS NATURE IDENTICAL & ARTIFICIAL (COCONUT)}, ANTIOXIDANT NS 307b), COLOURS (INS 150d) AND MINERAL
